chapter.title: LEO Station Keeping
chapter.para: Construct a new mission through the Resources and Mission trees, run an uncontrolled ten-day trajectory, and then add altitude control. The numerical settings below reproduce the shipped Ex_LEOStationKeeping.script. Earlier versions of this walkthrough used a different epoch, a single burn, different target goals and a different command order. Use the settings below when comparing with the shipped example.

listitem.para: Choose File, New. Rename DefaultSC to LEOsat and open its orbit form. Select UTCGregorian, epoch 01 Jan 2000 11:59:28.000, EarthMJ2000Eq and Cartesian. Set X, Y, Z, VX, VY and VZ to -4083.9, 4691.8, -2576.7, -4.252, -5.509, -3.284. Retain DryMass 850 kg, Cd 2.2, Cr 1.8, DragArea 15 square metres and SRPArea 1 square metre. Apply, then Close.
Rename DefaultProp to LEOprop. Retain RungeKutta89, InitialStepSize 60, Accuracy 1e-11, MinStep 0.001, MaxStep 2700, MaxStepAttempts 50 and StopIfAccuracyIsViolated true.

Open LEOprop_ForceModel. Keep CentralBody Earth, PrimaryBodies Earth and JGM2 degree/order 4. Set PointMasses to Luna, Sun and SRP On. Under Advanced, Gravity field, open Atmosphere. Select JacchiaRoberts; set both HistoricWeatherSource and PredictedWeatherSource to ConstantFluxAndGeoMag, F107 150, F107A 150 and MagneticIndex 3. Keep valid weather-file paths; the constant-source selections do not use their weather records. Click OK, Apply and Close.

Add two ImpulsiveBurn resources named TCM1 and TCM2. Keep Local coordinates, Earth origin, VNB axes, zero elements and DecrementMass false on both. Add a DifferentialCorrector named DC with its default numerical settings.
Add XYPlot1. Set X to LEOsat.A1ModJulian and Y to LEOsat.Earth.Altitude. Keep SolverIterations Current. Apply and Close.

section.title: Part 1: Uncontrolled Propagation
section.para: Delete the initial Propagate command. Append a While template to Mission Sequence, name it While1 and set Condition to LEOsat.ElapsedDays < 10 before Apply. Inside While1, append a Propagate using LEOprop and LEOsat with Single step checked. There is no separate initial step outside the loop. Apply and Close each command form. Save as a Part 1 mission, Run and observe the altitude plot.

section.title: Part 2: Add Altitude Control
section.para: Use Save As for a Part 2 mission. After the single-step Propagate inside While1, append an If with Condition LEOsat.Earth.Altitude < 342. The 342 km value is a trigger altitude, not a guaranteed lower bound. The Qt If template may contain an empty Else; leave that branch empty.
In the true branch, insert the following commands before Else. Configure their typed fields before Apply, then Close each form.

listitem.para: Propagate LEOprop and LEOsat to LEOsat.Earth.Periapsis. Leave Single step unchecked. This coast occurs before the Target branch.
Insert Target1 with Solver DC, SolveMode Solve and ExitMode DiscardAndContinue. Put the following seven commands inside it, in this order.
Vary DC, variable TCM1.Element1, Initial value 0.002, Perturbation 0.0001, Lower -9.999999e300, Upper 9.999999e300 and MaxStep 0.05.
Propagate LEOprop and LEOsat to LEOsat.Earth.Apoapsis.
Achieve with DC: Goal LEOsat.Earth.RMAG, Value 6737 and Tolerance 0.1. This is apoapsis radius, not SMA.
Vary DC, variable TCM2.Element1, Initial value 1e-5, Perturbation 0.00005, Lower -9.999999e300, Upper 9.999999e300 and MaxStep 0.05.
Achieve with DC: Goal LEOsat.Earth.ECC, Value 0.00005 and Tolerance 0.0001.

section.para: Save, Run and inspect target convergence and the altitude plot. Reopen the saved mission and verify the epoch, two distinct burns, periapsis coast, apoapsis-radius goal and target exit mode. Then compare with the unchanged shipped example. Viewer layouts and explicit default properties can differ without changing the simulation.
